aspectRatio.title: Aspect Ratio Calculator
aspectRatio.description: Calculate aspect ratios and resolutions, then position a crop with nine presets or sliders. Compare centered padding, review actual output size, and recover from copy or export failures.

common.title: Common Ratios
items: Link image example: 1200×630, with an exact ratio of 40:21
Choose other ratios such as 4:3 or 3:2. Platform presets are reference values; check the current requirements of the destination separately.

tips.title: Tips
items: Changing the target ratio of the same photo keeps its position. A successfully loaded replacement starts centered at 50/50.
If reading a replacement fails, the last valid image stays available. Older read or export results cannot restore an outdated photo.
The reference safe area is shown only on screen, never in the saved image. It is not a guarantee of the destination platform's actual UI.
PNG sources export as PNG; other supported images export as JPEG. Transparency from non-PNG sources is not preserved by JPEG.
CSS aspect-ratio:16 / 9; sets the proportions of a web element. Image content and filenames are excluded from share links.

whatIs.title: What is the Aspect Ratio Calculator?
whatIs.description: Calculate a width-to-height ratio and dimensions that preserve it. Preview an adjustable photo crop or centered padding, then export the same region. Calculation dimensions and actual image export limits are separate.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Enter width and height or select a ratio or resolution example. With ratio lock enabled, changing one side recalculates the other.
Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF of up to 8 MiB and 16,000,000 source pixels. Animations are processed as a still frame.
Use nine position buttons or two sliders in Crop mode. An axis without excess image area cannot move; padding remains centered.
Check the actual output dimensions and reduction notice near Save. Both the 8192-pixel long-side limit and 16,000,000-pixel total limit apply.
Copy dimensions, a ratio or CSS, or share the numeric setup. If copying fails, select the full text or retry.

items.a: Dividing both dimensions by their greatest common divisor,120, gives 16:9. Dimensions that are only close to that ratio are labeled separately.

items.q: Can I choose which part is cropped?
items.a: Use the nine position buttons or horizontal and vertical sliders in Crop mode. Only axes with excess source area can move. Preview and export use the same source region.

items.q: Why can exported dimensions differ from the calculation?
items.a: Export applies both an 8192-pixel long-side limit and a 16,000,000-pixel total limit. Review the actual dimensions and reduction notice. Extremely thin outputs that would round a side to 0 are rejected instead of stretched.

items.q: Which files and limits are supported?
items.a: PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF up to 8 MiB and 16,000,000 source pixels. Actual file content and decoded dimensions are checked. SVG and HEIC are unsupported, and animations use a still frame only.

items.q: Does a share link include the photo or crop position?
items.a: Current links contain width, height, ratio lock and the reference safe-area setting. Photos, filenames and crop position are excluded.

items.q: Is the safe area the latest official specification?
items.a: It is a reference overlay in this tool. It does not guarantee the latest platform UI and is not drawn into the file; check the real publishing environment separately.
